title: Wat Arun 3D — Virtual Riverside Sanctuary & Walkthrough Studio
description: A complete, self-contained interactive 3D walkthrough of Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn) on the Chao Phraya River in Bangkok, built in vanilla HTML5, CSS3 and ES6 with Three.js r128. It models the central Phra Prang with three circumambulatory galleries and a gilded finial, four satellite prangs, four corner mondops, an ubosot guarded by Thotsakan and Sahassa Deja, a six-sala riverfront, and an animated Chao Phraya. Features first-person walking with collision and jumping, a drone orbit mode, five bilingual EN/TH hotspots with narration, three time-of-day lighting presets, a real-time mini-map, Web Audio river/chime/footstep synthesis, photo bookmarks, localStorage autosave and portable JSON tour-journal export/import.

build.includes: Project scaffold; procedural stucco, porcelain, gold, granite, paving, roof and water textures; eleven-tier central prang with redented corners, three galleries, four steep pilgrim stairs, Indra-on-Erawan niche and gilded finial; four satellite prangs; four corner mondops; ubosot with chofah roof and two yaksha guardians; six green granite river salas; boardwalk, river landing, gate, naga rails, flag masts, planters, trees, blossoms, monks, boats and animated water; first-person walking with collision, sprint, jump and step-up; drone orbit; five bilingual EN/TH hotspots with narration; dawn, sunset and night lighting with floodlights, stars and environment mapping; bilingual UI; mini-map; spatial Web Audio synthesis; photo journal; localStorage autosave; JSON export/import; 28-check self-test; seven screenshots; documentation, licence, notices, robots, sitemap and GitHub Pages deployment.

features: Central Phra Prang of eleven tapering tiers, ~76 m tall, with redented corner buttresses, porcelain niches, gold cornices and friezes
Three circumambulatory galleries with balustrades, rails and gold corner spires
Four steep pilgrim staircases, four base stairways and a multi-pronged gilded finial
Gilded Indra on the three-headed elephant Erawan in the upper east niche
Four satellite prangs on the diagonal corners
Four corner mondops with columns, mosaic plinths, tiled roofs and gold finials
Ubosot with a five-bay porch, gilded doors and windows, steep tiled roof, chofah finials and two guardians
Thotsakan in green ceramic armour and Sahassa Deja in white, with tiered crowns, clubs, bared fangs and glowing eyes
Six green granite river salas with two-tier roofs, upturned gold eaves, benches and hanging lanterns
Raised stone boardwalk, river railing, mooring bollards, lamp posts, landing steps and a ceremonial gate with naga rails
Animated Chao Phraya with a seamless value-noise normal map, sky reflection and a gold reflection path
Three drifting long-tail boats with canopies, long-tail shafts and wakes
Seventeen trees with pink frangipani blossoms, hedges, planters, flag masts and saffron-robed monks
First-person walk with WASD/arrow movement, sprint, jump, head bob and distance-synced footsteps
Collision detection against towers, halls, salas, trees, walls, lamps and the river boundary; step-up for ramps and stairs
Pointer-lock mouse look plus a drag-look fallback
Drone orbit with 360° rotation, pitch limits, zoom 16–270 m and target panning
Five floating hotspots with pulsing sprites, beams and ground rings; proximity auto-open, click and E-key interaction
Bilingual English/Thai hotspot cards with three paragraphs, a pull quote and device-voice narration
Instant EN/TH switching across every label, description, zone, hint and toast
Three lighting presets: Golden Dawn, Sunset Glow and Night Illumination
Six warm floodlights, three promenade point lights, stars, clouds, moon fill and an environment map generated from the sky
Real-time top-down mini-map with courtyard plan, river, player position and view cone
Web Audio river bed with slow LFO, pentatonic wind chimes and synthesised footsteps
Photo bookmarks captured from the WebGL canvas and stored as compact JPEG data URLs
Autosave of visits, photos, language, preset and audio settings to localStorage
Portable watarun_3d_journal.json export and import, including photo thumbnails
Responsive desktop, tablet and phone layouts with a touch look area, four-way pad and hotspot drawer
28-check self-test at ?selftest=1
GitHub Pages deployment
